description: How an editor shell presents its Left and Right panels on a Tablet layout. Docked keeps the docked columns (rails, at most one expanded); Overlay turns the Left panel into an overlay drawer and the Right panel into a non-modal side sheet over a full-width canvas, at most one open. Desktop and mobile are not affected.

members.name: Docked
members.description: The panels stay docked columns (a slim rail when collapsed, at most one expanded, resizable). The behaviour of every earlier version.

members.name: Overlay
members.description: The Left panel is an overlay drawer, the Right panel a non-modal side sheet, over a canvas that keeps its full width. At most one is open, there are no rails and no resize separators, and Escape closes the open one.
